# geoipupdate 8.0.0

BookmarksSync's Windows installer includes the official MaxMind `geoipupdate` 8.0.0 Windows amd64 executable. It downloads only the GeoLite2 Country database when an administrator configures it in Admin Settings.

Upstream project: [github.com/maxmind/geoipupdate](https://github.com/maxmind/geoipupdate)

The upstream archive is `geoipupdate_8.0.0_windows_amd64.zip`, published at the `v8.0.0` release. Its SHA-256 is `1aadec5283389670729b1332ca938e3cf12a1413853c30a2193cfe9d3fc8bbea`.

The upstream distribution contains code under Apache License 2.0 and MIT License. Their complete texts are included in `LICENSE-APACHE` and `LICENSE-MIT`.
